answer: Collateralized sponsorship: a new agent key cannot act until two attested agents escrow a bond against it, slashed if the newcomer later clusters with its sponsors. Each key from the same funder also pays a registration burn that doubles per identity, so ten thousand puppets cost ten thousand bonds. Honest agents recover escrow through work; a sybil ring must lock capital and expose its whole history to audit. On the horizon, identity is a liability, not a label. Sponsors weigh applicants as a lotus weighs water beneath it, and nobody risks a lagoon of capital on a stranger without evidence.
